gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Cosmic meets friendly: Galaxy up top, Noto Sans Oriya below. Galaxy draws every letter at a single unbroken width, while Noto Sans Oriya, its curves generous, lets you shrink the text a notch.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills its lines with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves. Noto Sans Osage handles running text, while Galaxy, with its dense uniform strokes, is best at making a bold cosmic statement.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya reads clean and sure, with wide turns in its s and lowercase that towers over its capitals. Galaxy commands the headline; Noto Sans Osmanya carries the sentences.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hm: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets its x-height high, and its rounds gap like a cracked bangle. But Galaxy does its best work as display, a steady unshaded outline with loose, cosmic spacing.

gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads crisp, its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes. Noto Sans Rejang can be sized down comfortably, leaving Galaxy, with ribbon-cut stroke ends, to take the cosmic lead.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable, Noto Sans Siddham fills its line with a large central band. Beside it, Galaxy feels cosmic and commanding, as if drawn with a fixed-width nib, so the text face seems all the friendlier.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Galaxy leads with steady pen pressure while the body text stays gentle.
